main_text.p: Princeps, ut Celsitudinem Vestram ad nominis sui gloriam perpetuo in-columem servet.
main_text.head: XLVIII. EXEMPLAR LITTERARUM Ad Duces OTTHONEM Brunsvicensem, ET CHRISTOPHORUM Megapolensem.
main_text.p: CUm à Serenissimo Rege Navarreno jussus fuerim apud Illustrissimos Germaniae Principes de certaminibus in Religione componendis, & ratione depellendorum Pontificis Roma-

page.notes: Engraved or ornamental rule and initial C (woodcut initial) at start of the main letter. Small-capital headline "ILLUSTRISSIME PRINCEPS." is a heading in spaced capitals, rendered as a paragraph above. Some stray specks and ink marks on the scan, not transcribed. The page ends mid-word: "Roma-" continues on the next page.
